item.title: My Bupa Onboarding: TechVision, Savannah27 and the Jagjeevan Mindset
item.description: Sometimes, a new beginning doesn’t just introduce you to a new organisation. It helps you rediscover what you have believed in all along. A new beginning, a familiar purpose It has been a month since I began my journey with Bupa as Head of Engineering at Bupa Capability Centre (BCC), India. As I work through onboarding, and learn more about Bupa, I find a strong connection between its purpose and my personal philosophy: Jagjeevan — Living Larger Than Life📕.
